Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Monroeville for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, at least 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (the Monroeville Festival of Trees, December 4 and 5) through December 12 (Winter Wonderland), with Santa at Sardis in Murrysville (December 5) and the Monroeville Public Library's Grinchmas and Christmas Storytime along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Monroeville

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Monroeville, Murrysville and Plum
  • Free events, including the Monroeville Festival of Trees and the Recreation and Parks Winter Wonderland (recount the two library cards from the live page)
  • Meet Santa: Festival of Trees (December 4 and 5), Santa at Sardis in Murrysville (December 5) and Winter Wonderland (December 12)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Plum WinterFest (December 4) has a tree lighting; the Plum parade on December 13 and 14 is Facebook-only and held
  • Trains: none found for Monroeville; see the Pittsburgh page for the Santa Trolley
  • Season: December 4 to December 12

Planning a bigger day out? Monroeville families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Pittsburgh, which covers Phipps Holiday Magic, Kennywood Holiday Lights and the Santa Trolley at the Pennsylvania Trolley Museum.
